arabic text: EK BAAR AUR MUJHE GODH MAY LE LO BABA
english translation text: BABA, HOLD ME IN YOUR LAP ONE MORE TIME

arabic text: WA HUSSAINA KA HUA SHOR HARAM MAY BARPA\nHO KE RUQSAT JO CHALE GHAR SE SHAHE KARBOBALA\nKEHKE YE DAUDI SAKINA KE TEHER JAO ZARA
english translation text: THE CRY OF 'WA HUSSAINA' ROSE THROUGH THE TENTS\nAS THE SHAH OF KARBALA LEFT THE CAMP AFTER HIS FAREWELL\nSAKINA RAN, SAYING: WAIT A MOMENT

arabic text: EK BAAR AUR MUJHE GODH MAY LE LO BABA
english translation text: BABA, HOLD ME IN YOUR LAP ONE MORE TIME

arabic text: SHEH NE BACHI KA JO YE HAAL PARESHAN DEKHA\nROKE FARMAYA KE KYA HAAL MERI MAHELEKHA\nJOD KAR NANHE SE HAATHON KO SAKINA NE KAHA
english translation text: WHEN THE SHAH SAW HIS LITTLE GIRL IN SUCH DISTRESS\nHE WEPT AND SAID: WHAT IS WRONG, MY MOON-FACED ONE?\nJOINING HER TINY HANDS, SAKINA SAID

arabic text: EK BAAR AUR MUJHE GODH MAY LE LO BABA
english translation text: BABA, HOLD ME IN YOUR LAP ONE MORE TIME

arabic text: SOCHTI HOO KE TAMACHE KOI MAARE NA MERE\nGOSHWARE KOI KAANO SE UTAARE NA MERE\nWEHM AATE HAI MERE DIL MAY NA JAANE KYA KYA
english translation text: I KEEP THINKING: WILL SOMEONE STRIKE ME WITH SLAPS?\nWILL SOMEONE TEAR THE EARRINGS FROM MY EARS?\nMY HEART IS FILLED WITH FEARS I CANNOT EVEN NAME

arabic text: EK BAAR AUR MUJHE GODH MAY LE LO BABA
english translation text: BABA, HOLD ME IN YOUR LAP ONE MORE TIME

arabic text: BABA SEENE SE SAKINA KO LAGATE JAO\nAB KAHAN HOGI MULAQAAT BATATE JAO\nTUMKO AKBAR KI QASAM GHUNCHA DAHAN KA SADQA
english translation text: BABA, HOLD SAKINA CLOSE TO YOUR CHEST BEFORE YOU GO\nTELL ME, WHERE WILL WE MEET AGAIN NOW?\nI BEG YOU BY AKBAR, AND FOR THE SAKE OF YOUR ROSEBUD-MOUTHED ASGHAR

arabic text: EK BAAR AUR MUJHE GODH MAY LE LO BABA
english translation text: BABA, HOLD ME IN YOUR LAP ONE MORE TIME

arabic text: AB MAI PYASI HOO NA PANI KI ZAROORAT HAI MUJHE\nKOI HAAJAT NAHI BAS ITNI SI HASRAT HAI MUJHE\nDEKHLOO PHIR SE JEE BHAR KE TUMHARA CHEHRA
english translation text: I AM NO LONGER THIRSTY; I HAVE NO NEED OF WATER\nI HAVE NO OTHER NEED, ONLY THIS SMALL LONGING REMAINS\nLET ME LOOK ONCE MORE UPON YOUR FACE TO MY HEART'S CONTENT
